module_summary: Four-state Moore FSM (walk left/right, fall left/right) steered by bump and ground inputs, with outputs decoded from the state register.

anchors.name: state
anchors.why: Lemming FSM state register; next-state case and all outputs decode it.

anchors.name: walk_left
anchors.why: Moore output decoded from state WL.

anchors.name: walk_right
anchors.why: Moore output decoded from state WR.

anchors.name: aaah
anchors.why: Falling indication decoded from FALLL or FALLR states.

groups.name: lemming_fsm
groups.description: Walk/fall state machine driven by bump and ground conditions.

groups.name: output_decode
groups.description: Decodes state into walk_left, walk_right and aaah outputs.
